kind: synthetic SDK store controls; no native SDK acceptance

cases.name: key ordering is stable and every input family invalidates
owned initialization refuses foreign roots and nonempty data
publish, explicit digest admission and multiple readers preserve bytes
different outputs for equal inputs remain separate immutable versions
short input locators verify the full identity before accepting a hit
separate processes share readers but cannot evict an active reader
source mutation during publish preserves staging and exposes no complete entry
changed, extra and missing files fail integrity without timestamp shortcuts
coherently rewritten manifest cannot replace an independently retained digest
mutation during a reader lease is detected on close and releases the lease
quarantine retains original bytes and a missing entry is a cache miss
portable path grammar refuses traversal, streams and device names
